### D-099 — WELL_KNOWN_LAYERS and the template file list moved to blong-lib

> _2026-09-12 · core/blong-lib · active_

`WELL_KNOWN_LAYERS` and `listTemplateFiles` now live in `@feasibleone/blong-lib` behind the subpath
exports `./layers` and `./template`, and gogo re-exports `src/template-files.ts` unchanged so
`copy-template.mjs` and `kopi.ts` keep working. `**/.tap/**` was added to the ignore list at the
same time, because it was leaking hundreds of coverage files into every scaffolded realm.
